### GET /api/v1/conversations

List inbox conversations

Requires `inbox:read`. Reply and mention conversations across the workspace's connected accounts, newest first. `?postId=` scopes to one published post (for an in-composer replies panel); `?type=` selects replies vs mentions, omit it for both. Reads the local store — call POST /conversations/sync to refresh from the platforms.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |
| `status` | one of `"open"` | `"resolved"` | `"snoozed"` | no |  |
| `platform` | one of `"bluesky"` | `"twitter"` | `"threads"` | `"mastodon"` | `"facebook_page"` | `"instagram"` | `"linkedin_page"` | no |  |
| `type` | one of `"reply"` | `"mention"` | no |  |
| `postId` | string | no |  |
| `accountId` | string | no |  |
| `assignee` | string | no | Ownership scope: `me` (session caller's own), `unassigned`, or a userId |
| `inboxId` | string | no | Scope to one team inbox (Inbox 2.0) |
| `cursor` | string | no |  |
| `limit` | integer (min 1, max 100) | no |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — A page of conversations
  - `ConversationList`
    - `conversations`: array of `ConversationSummary`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `platform`: string, required — Platform id, e.g. "bluesky"
      - `accountId`: string, required
      - `type`: one of `"reply"` | `"mention"`, required
      - `status`: one of `"open"` | `"resolved"` | `"snoozed"`, required
      - `participant`: `ConversationParticipant`, required
        - `handle`: string, required

### GET /api/v1/conversations/count

Count the conversations in a view

Requires `inbox:read`. How many conversations a view holds — what the inbox's badges show. It takes the same filters as `GET /conversations` (`type`, `assignee`, `inboxId`, `platform`, `accountId`, `postId`), so a badge counts exactly what selecting that view lists, plus `status` (open by default). `unread=true` narrows to conversations whose latest activity is an incoming message nobody has read yet — what the app's sidebar badge counts, which is a different question from how much is still open. A session caller that names no `organizationId` falls back to its active workspace, reading 0 when it has none.

**Auth:** API key or session

| `type` | one of `"reply"` | `"mention"` | no |  |
| `postId` | string | no |  |
| `accountId` | string | no |  |
| `assignee` | string | no | Ownership scope: `me` (session caller's own), `unassigned`, or a userId |
| `inboxId` | string | no | Scope to one team inbox (Inbox 2.0) |
| `status` | one of `"open"` | `"resolved"` | `"snoozed"` | no |  |
| `unread` | one of `"true"` | `"false"` | no | Only conversations with unread incoming activity |

**Responses**

- `200` — The count
  - object
    - `count`: integer, required

### POST /api/v1/conversations/sync

Pull fresh replies from the platforms

Requires `inbox:update` — a sync writes the shared store and spends the platforms' metered read budget. Ingests replies for the workspace's in-scope published posts (X/Threads/Bluesky) through the platform adapters into the inbox store. Backs the "Sync now" button and the on-open refresh. Idempotent — re-running only inserts genuinely new replies. Skipped (with `skipped: true`) when a sync ran within the last 2 minutes, unless `force` is set. Forced syncs are rate limited per credential.

**Auth:** API key or session
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- object
  - `organizationId`: string — Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace.
  - `force`: boolean — Bypass the recent-sync cooldown (used by the explicit "Sync now" button)

**Responses**

- `200` — Sync summary
  - `InboxSyncResult`
    - `fetched`: integer, required
    - `inserted`: integer, required
    - `perPlatform`: object, required
    - `errors`: array of object, required
      - `platform`: string, required
      - `accountId`: string, required
      - `message`: string, required
    - `skipped`: boolean — True when the sync was skipped because one ran within the cooldown window; pass force to override
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `429` — Rate limit exceeded
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/conversations/snooze-all

Bulk snooze conversations

### POST /api/v1/conversations/pending-replies/{pendingReplyId}/decide

Approve, edit & approve, or reject a held reply

Requires `approval:decide`. `approve` sends the drafted reply as-is; `edit_approve` sends `body` instead; `reject` records `note` back to the drafter and sends nothing. Approving publishes through the platform — a send that fails after approval returns 502 with the reply in `failed`, retryable by deciding again (as is an approval whose send never finished, once `decidable` turns true). A decider can't approve a reply attributed to themselves unless they could have sent it directly (`inbox:reply`). Approvals are rate limited per credential; rejections are not.

**Auth:** API key or session
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

| `pendingReplyId` | string | yes |  |

  - `note`: string — A note back to the drafter (the reject reason)

### POST /api/v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages

Reply in a conversation

Publishes a reply through the platform (reusing the adapter's comment path — no scheduled post is created) and appends it to the thread, when the caller holds `inbox:reply`. A caller who lacks it but holds `approval:request` (a gated member, or a key scoped that way) does not 403: the reply is captured as a blocking approval and returned with 202 — it never reaches the platform until an `approval:decide` holder releases it (see /conversations/pending-replies). The reply targets the conversation's post, or the specific comment named by `replyToMessageId`.

**Auth:** API key or session
**Rate limited:** yes (429 when the per-credential budget is spent)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `conversationId` | string | yes |  |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- object
  - `text`: string (default "")
  - `replyToMessageId`: string | null — Reply to a specific comment (its message id). Omit to reply to the post.
  - `media`: array of object — Optional attachments (e.g. a GIF)
    - `url`: string, required
    - `mimeType`: string, required
    - `altText`: string
    - `sourceUrl`: string
    - `videoUrl`: string
    - `width`: number
    - `height`: number
    - `bytes`: number
  - `organizationId`: string — Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace.

**Responses**

- `200` — The conversation with the sent reply appended
  - `ConversationDetail`
    - `id`: string, required
    - `platform`: string, required — Platform id, e.g. "bluesky"
    - `accountId`: string, required
    - `type`: one of `"reply"` | `"mention"`, required
    - `status`: one of `"open"` | `"resolved"` | `"snoozed"`, required
    - `participant`: `ConversationParticipant`, required
      - `handle`: string, required
      - `displayName`: string, required
      - `avatarUrl`: string | null, required
    - `lastMessagePreview`: string, required
    - `lastMediaKind`: one of `"image"` | `"gif"` | `"video"` | `null`, required — Media kind of the latest reply for a list glyph; null if text-only
    - `lastMessageAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601
    - `unread`: boolean, required
    - `snoozedUntil`: string | null, required — ISO 8601 wake time when status is "snoozed"; null otherwise
    - `assigneeUserId`: string | null, required — User id of the teammate who owns this conversation; null when unassigned
    - `contentExpired`: boolean, required — The participant and preview were dropped because the platform's retention window passed (LinkedIn caps member data at 24 hours). Reading the conversation re-fetches them.
    - `originalPost`: object | null, required — The published post being replied to, pinned on top
      - `id`: string, required
      - `text`: string, required
      - `platformUrl`: string | null, required
      - `platformPostId`: string | null, required
      - `author`: object, required
        - `handle`: string, required
        - `avatarUrl`: string | null, required
      - `createdAt`: string | null, required
    - `messages`: array of `ConversationMessage`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `direction`: one of `"in"` | `"out"`, required
      - `author`: `ConversationParticipant`, required
        - `handle`: string, required
        - `displayName`: string, required
        - `avatarUrl`: string | null, required
      - `text`: string, required
      - `media`: array of `ConversationMedia`, required — Images / GIFs / video attached to the message
        - `kind`: one of `"image"` | `"gif"` | `"video"`, required
        - `url`: string, required — Displayable URL (image, GIF, or video poster)
        - `videoUrl`: string | null — Playable video source (for video, and an mp4 alt for a GIF)
        - `altText`: string | null
        - `width`: number | null
        - `height`: number | null
      - `permalinkUrl`: string | null, required
      - `createdAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601
      - `platformReplyId`: string | null, required — Remote id of this reply — the target when replying to it
      - `parentPlatformId`: string | null, required — Remote id of the post/reply this one replies to (thread structure)
      - `contentExpired`: boolean, required — Text, media and author were dropped because the platform's retention window passed; the detail read re-fetches them when it can.
- `202` — The caller can't publish directly; the reply is held for approval
  - object
    - `held`: literal `true`, required
    - `pendingReply`: `PendingReplySummary`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `conversationId`: string, required
      - `organizationId`: string, required
      - `status`: one of `"pending"` | `"approved"` | `"rejected"` | `"sent"` | `"failed"`, required
      - `body`: string, required
      - `media`: array of `PendingReplyMedia`, required
        - `url`: string, required
        - `mimeType`: string, required
        - `altText`: string
        - `sourceUrl`: string
        - `videoUrl`: string
        - `width`: number
        - `height`: number
        - `bytes`: number
      - `replyToMessageId`: string | null, required
      - `decisionNote`: string | null, required
      - `sendError`: string | null, required — Why the platform send failed, for a `failed` reply
      - `createdAt`: string, required — ISO 8601
      - `decidedAt`: string | null, required — ISO 8601
      - `decidable`: boolean, required — Whether an `approval:decide` holder can act on it now: `pending`, `failed`, or `approved` with a send that never finished (retryable after 10 minutes)
      - `draftedBy`: `PendingReplyUser`, required
        - `id`: string, required
        - `name`: string, required
        - `avatarUrl`: string | null, required
      - `decidedBy`: `PendingReplyUser` | null, required
        - `id`: string, required
        - `name`: string, required
        - `avatarUrl`: string | null, required
      - `conversation`: object, required
        - `platform`: string, required
        - `participantHandle`: string, required
        - `participantDisplayName`: string, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
- `429` — Rate limit exceeded
  - `Error`
- `502` — The platform rejected the reply
